subject: MSA + Order Form: scope alignment, signer matrix, and exhibit questions
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@skylab.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@skylab.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MSA + Order Form attached — scope and signer questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Attached is the latest MSA and a brief Exhibit A that our product team put together. A few items we want to clarify up front so contracting doesn't stall our integration timeline: 

- Exhibit A: the scope lists three ingestion endpoints. We expect a fourth (webhook ingestion) to be included — is that a minor exhibit update or does it change pricing?
- Signer matrix: Our legal team prefers a single-signatory flow (CEO for us). Are you able to accept a single signatory on the Order Form and countersign on the MSA?
- SLA & data residency: we need a 99.9% availability target and EU data residency for EU customers — is that something Redwood can commit to per region?

I've attached Skylab_ExhibitA_Scope.pdf and flagged the relevant sections. Please let me know which questions you want us to answer vs. which you prefer Redwood legal to propose language for.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Partnerships | Skylab AI
attachments: Skylab_ExhibitA_Scope.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@skylab.ai>, contracts@skylab.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form attached — scope and signer questions

Kimberly / Marissa / Jonas — forwarding Skylab's draft and initial asks. Quick context: Skylab is a mid-market AI platform; target first deployment in Q1 2026. They want to add webhook ingestion (Exhibit A) and are proposing single signatory on the Order Form. They also raised SLA + EU residency asks.

Requested immediate items:
1) Quick read on whether webhook addition materially changes pricing or liability footprint — if it’s a non-material scope add, we can treat as Exhibit update.
2) Signer approach: they prefer CEO-only signing the Order Form. Would Redwood accept that with countersignature on the MSA? Any risk or policy blockers?
3) SLA/residency: can we map standard Redwood region commitments and propose language for EU residency carve-out if needed?

I've attached the Redwood_MSA_v2.docx they received earlier (internal copy). If you can reply with a prioritized list of edits and which items need external confirmation, I’ll coordinate with Skylab and schedule a short triage call.

Thanks — Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@skylab.ai>, contracts@skylab.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form attached — scope and signer questions

Thanks Jordan / Alyssa — quick legal triage below (high level first, then line items I think we should raise):

High-level:
- Webhook ingestion: technically an additional integration vector but doesn't change core hosting/residency model. Treat as Exhibit A update with a short definition of "ingestion endpoints" and an explicit list. Pricing: usually negligible unless it materially increases token volume. Recommend we accept as Exhibit change and reserve right to revisit pricing at the next renewal.
- Single-signatory Order Form: acceptable only if (a) Order Form explicitly references the governing MSA, (b) the person signing has authority per a signed signer matrix or board resolution, and (c) Skylab confirms billing contact and PO flow. We prefer MSA to be signed by an authorized officer on Redwood's side as counterparty acceptance.
- SLA & EU residency: 99.9% availability ask is within our Dedicated SLA band but not the default hosted tier. We can offer 99.9% for a regionalized deployment (Dedicated or Dedicated-edge) with a related pricing uplift. For EU residency of customer data, need to confirm whether Skylab will be sending EU end-customer data or Redwood must isolate storage per customer — propose a scoped residency clause and an attachment about data flows.

Line items to propose in near-term redline: 
1) Exhibit A: add "webhook ingestion" bullet + sample throughput limits and an explicit statement that changes to endpoints may trigger pricing review at renewal.
2) Signatory language: add sentence to Order Form that signatory represents and warrants authority; require a signer matrix or signed attestation.
3) SLA: offer a route: (a) standard hosted (best-effort), (b) 99.9% regionalized SLA for Dedicated (cost uplift). We'll draft two short blocks.
4) Data residency: add carveout/attachment describing residency responsibilities and any obligations for customer-provided keys.

Next steps I recommend: Jordan schedules a 30-minute call with Skylab legal + product so we can run exhibit specifics. I'll prepare a redline with the above bullets and a suggested Order Form clause for single-signature acceptance by end of day tomorrow.

Attachments referenced: proposed_ExhibitA_template.docx (internal) — I will attach in my redline email.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@skylab.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, contracts@skylab.ai
Date: 2025-11-06T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form attached — scope and signer questions

Hi Kimberly / team — thanks for the rapid triage and clear options. That approach works for Skylab. A few clarifications before the call: 

- We can provide a signer attestation from our CEO for the Order Form.
- Webhook ingestion expected burst: max 120 rps during peak; average 18 rps. If you could add a simple throughput line in Exhibit A, that will be perfect.
- For the SLA, Skylab prefers the 99.9% regionalized option — can you send the uplift % so we can budget?

Let's do the 30-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT — Jordan, can you send a calendar invite and include a short shared doc for Exhibit A edits so we can iterate live?

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Partnerships | Skylab AI
